item.title: Satya Nadella says we should assume all AI models are ‘compromised’
item.description: In a lengthy post on X, Microsoft's CEO laid out his views on the dangers posed by highly advanced AI models and how to confront those risks. Nadella says we can no longer accept a world where AI is treated as a "set of nested black boxes" whose advice and actions we simply accept or […]

item.title: WoW: Forever's classes won't be modernized, but Blizzard has added some new mechanics for 'engaging depth' as 'some classes' in World of Warcraft Classic 'were too simple'
item.description: Blizzard confirmed it won't modernize WoW: Forever's classes, as it wants to align with the "Classic" experience, but some will receive more "engaging depth."

item.title: How does using your MacBook while charging affect its battery life?

item.title: Microsoft’s Satya Nadella says AI models need an ‘emergency brake’
item.description: In a Saturday morning post, Microsoft's CEO wrote that it’s time “to step back and assess the trust architecture” of AI.
